name: 二阶梯度分析
description: Computes 2nd-order gradient for 文本ure analysis (Wang, 2019)
algorithm: Second Order Gradient — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes second-order gradient features for image forensic analysis:

1. **Second-OrderDerivative计算**: Second-order partial derivatives (∂²I/∂x², ∂²I/∂y², ∂²I/∂x∂y) are computed, capturing the rate of change of image gradients. These measure edge sharpness, curvature, and texture acceleration — properties sensitive to image generation and processing.

2. **Hessian矩阵分析**: The 2×2 Hessian matrix H(x,y) = [[∂²I/∂x², ∂²I/∂x∂y], [∂²I/∂x∂y, ∂²I/∂y²]] is computed at each pixel. Eigenvalue analysis of the Hessian reveals local surface curvature — ridges, valleys, and flat regions. The distribution of Hessian eigenvalues characterizes image structure.

3. **Curvature模式分析**: The principal curvatures (Hessian eigenvalues) and their directions reveal edge profile shapes. Natural edges show specific curvature profiles from optical blur. AI-generated edges may show different curvature — sharper (lacking optical blur), more uniform (from generation smoothing), or with curvature discontinuities at generation boundaries.

4. **Second-OrderStatistics**: Statistical moments of second-order derivatives are computed in local windows. Natural images follow specific distributions (typically super-Gaussian). AI generation may produce different second-order statistics — particularly in the relationship between first and second order derivatives, which reflects the image's underlying generative process.

5. **Multi-ScaleSecond-Order分析**: Second-order features are computed at multiple scales (using Gaussian scale-space). The scale-dependent behavior of second-order statistics characterizes the imaging pipeline. AI generation produces different multi-scale second-order behavior than camera capture.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 图像
输入: 原始像素数据 / 图像文件
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
处理方式: 客户端 Canvas API
色彩空间: RGB、灰度（视情况而定）
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-90% 独立准确率. 在未压缩图像上性能最佳 and 在重度JPEG压缩或社交媒体重新编码时可能降低.
source: 数字图像取证研究。基于信号处理和计算摄影原理.
useCase: 通过以下方式检测AI生成或篡改的图像： second order gradient 分析。该方法识别AI生成特有的模式和伪影，为全面的图像取证分析做出贡献.
strengths:
• 使用 Canvas API 快速客户端处理
• 有效检测特定的AI生成伪影
• 支持常见图像格式（JPEG、PNG、WebP）
• 可与互补的分析方法组合使用
• 基于成熟的图像取证研究
limitations:
• 性能可能因图像压缩级别而异
• 社交媒体重新编码可能影响准确性
• 最好与其他取证方法结合使用
• 对经过大量处理的真实图像可能产生误报
• 有效性取决于所使用的AI生成模型

references.title: Gonzalez, R.C. & Woods, R.E. (2018). Digital Image Processing. 4th Edition. Pearson.
Fridrich, J. & Kodovsky, J. (2012). Rich Models for Steganalysis of Digital Images. IEEE TIFS.
